notes.title: Game update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/dfb5926f06fd2fc32bc005c3fbccb901461e7400.jpg[/img]

Friends! 

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/5a8ee90c58382c0012180b22f26d644946742055.png[/img]

Defenders, merry Christmas and happy New Year! 

We hope that your mood is up and you are pleasantly waiting for the New Year to come. To make the atmosphere even more festive, we’ve prepared new mythic cards for you, which are made following the corresponding «snowy» theme. 

By the way, please note that [b]the first «red» spell has appeared[/b] in Defenders 2! Don’t miss the chance to try it in action 

[quote][h3]Greet the new mythic cards: [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img]⠀[b]Christmas tree[/b] — a cheap tower that makes creeps confused. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img]⠀[b]Snowball[/b] — a flying tower that drops snowballs on the creeps. It deals heavy damage to them and slows all enemies it hits down. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img]⠀[b]Time warp[/b] — this spell slows the creeps down (except those that are immune to slowdown), dispels all positive effects from them and does not allow them to cast spells. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img]⠀New Heroine, [b]Lady Frost[/b], increases the number of available mythic towers upgrades in battle.[/quote]
We would like to kindly remind you that this content is made for high-level players, meaning that it gets unlocked only once you reach level 70. «Red» tower and new spell shards can be received by opening special boosters that are sold for red shards at the Shop. 

At the same time, Christmas event begins at the same time this update gets installed on our servers. Level 70+ players can earn red crystals and other high-level content for participating in it. Players below level 70 will have an opportunity to get valuable prizes that are especially useful on the early phase of the game! 

What is more, one more great surprise aways players of ALL levels: you will get a chance to receive a [b]new legendary Heroine[/b], — [b]Snow Maiden[/b], — by participating in the event. Thanks to her, almost all towers and their upgrades will cost less during the battle. The effect the Heroine provides does not apply only to mythic towers. Please note that you can get this Heroine only during the event at the current state of the game! 

You can even more details about the Christmas event in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/d76439f3cbb34df745181c2ad68865c393bc2092.png[/img]

We’ve completely revised the reward system in Defenders 2, and now you will be receiving a lot more trophies for victories than before! 

Now you get the same prizes for victories in both PvE- and PvP-modes — chests with 5 random trophies. Among them, you can find Silver, Essences, Keys, Feeders, Runes, Tower or Spell cards or their shards. The type of the chests and the rarity of the rewards you get depends on your account level. Players without an active Premium subscription will receive 1 or 2 chests per victory, and the ones who own it will get from 2 to 4 chests per victory. This way, you will be getting from 5 to 20 trophies for each win instead of 1-2! 

Please note that you will receive chests for victories in mines, too. At the same time: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] captured PvP-mines will continue to bring resources (Silver or Essences); 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] you will still be getting league chests in league mines upon the end of the competition (new chests are given for in-between victories). 

Same as before, there are 4 available rewards on each of the arenas. You will be seeing them before the launch of the battle. Among the rewards, you may find chests that belong to one of the groups: rare, special, epic, and legendary. The quality of chests is determined by the player’s account level — the higher it is, the sweeter the reward! 

Reward renewal function has not changed. If you do not like the chest you are getting for the future fight, you can change the reward you receive for stars. At the same time, the new reward will be either of the same worth as the previous one, or of a better one (it can not be of a lesser worth than the old one). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/9b946bd7dcd4a7bc8cb459909d034f93780108b6.png[/img]

We’ve removed all old boosters from the game, excluding heroic and mythic ones, and replaced them with more relevant offers. Now you can purchase rare, special, epic, and legendary chests at the Shop. Level 70+ players can still purchase mythic boosters there. 

Rewarded ads now grant a rare chest instead of rare booster but only to players below level 70. Limited to one reward per hour with up to five rewards per day. 

We also changed rewards for the one-time purchase of 10 Boosters/Chests. 

What is more, we’ve prepared a pleasant bonus for you! For the first purchase of stars, you will get twice the premium currency! The offer applies to all boosters independently, that is, purchasing each of them can grant you a double sum of stars! 

Changes affected the Weekly Offers Shop too. In celebration of New Year and Christmas, we removed legendary All-Purpose Gears from it… and replaced them by mythic All-Purpose Gears — at the same price! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/16a8f1eaa4b1a338913edbbcb1327bf84e2df0c3.png[/img]

We’ve prepared a list of other changes that will make it a lot more comfortable to play Defenders 2. 

So, window mode has become available in the desktop version of the game! You can turn it on in the setting menu. The size of the window is fixed:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] on UltraWide and SuperUltraWide displays, the size of the screen is determined by the height of the screen, 16:9 aspect ratio; 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] on 4K displays (Ultra HD), the window mode will run in 2K (2560x1440); 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] on 2K displays — FullHD (1920x1080); 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] on FullHD displays — HD (1280x720); 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] if your display resolution is smaller than FullHD, the size of the window will always be equal to 1280x720.

Improved multiple sale mode work. You can no longer sell locked cards. 

Improved Spider Nest effects. 

For the following towers, we’ve balanced out the Skill, Ascension & Ingenuity Runes effects: regular and league Sky Eye, regular and league Prime Injector, Detector and Locator, Engineering and Repairing Towers, regular and league Horrifying Tower, Frost Guard, Frost Tower, Shiny Crest, Colony of bats, Spider nest, and Aim Tower. Now, upon upgrading during the fight, their range gets increased by 5% instead of 20%. Aim tower will no longer make the range of the enlisted towers unreasonably wide. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png[/img]

We’ve also fixed up a few things in the game: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] If inserted into League Sky Eye, Skill Rune increases the tower's range instead of damage it deals.

notes.title: Game update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg[/img]

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/76bf220e08c206ebe32a7857ec1d066723a86d77.png[/img]

Defenders! You all know that we watch closely your feedback and comments. We were glad to see how much you liked the new towers and Heroes. It inspired us to create more fascinating and unusual mythic cards. The last cards were Halloween-themed. This time we fixed upon queer and yet so enchanting steampunk!

[quote][h1]Introducing new mythic cards:[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Tower of Chaos[/b] — fires energy charges that pierce through the creeps, dealing AoE damage. Has a 30% chance of making the monsters confused for 5 seconds.
[*] [b]Aim Tower[/b] — increases the range and damage dealt by nearby towers. Cannot be taken in battle alongside with Prime Injector.
[*] [b]Tower of Order[/b] — slows the creeps down, dispels healing, speed up, and armor enhancement effects, making them immune to those effects for 5 seconds.
[*] [b]Heroine Chronicle[/b] — increases the duration of mythic towers' effects.
[/list][/quote]
Quick reminder: mythic cards are high-level content that is why it unlocks when your account reaches level 70. You can find previously added and new towers and Heroes in special boosters for red crystals.

Speaking of red crystals. It turned out Inventor stored up quite a few of them so he'd gladly exchange them for some Gear Wheels he needs so much!

[h1]A new event launches together with this Defenders 2 update[/h1]
Participate in battles, collect mechanisms, use then to spin the Wheel of Fortune, and get random guaranteed prizes. Players of level 70 and above can earn crystals and other high-level content through the event. Players below level 70 can get other valuable prizes — ones that will be more useful at the early stage of the game. You can learn more about the event in the game itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/7b2d8aec2e810acd0c6f18a1cc7ba0c2ed2e9796.png[/img]

We know how badly you wanted to see this feature in the game, so here it goes — at your request:

[h1]Now you can sell several cards at the same time![/h1]
To do so, click on a card in the collection menu and hold it until you see a suggestion to select other cards. Select all necessary cards and/or shards and press "Sell".

At the same time, you'll see prices displayed on the cards in the multiple sale mode. Press "Sell" and a confirm box will appear with the amount you'll gain.

[quote][h1]Please note that:[/h1][list]
[*] It's possible to sell a card with zero shards but for a corresponding price — 0 tokens.
[*] Runes are still sold by the piece.
[/list][/quote]
You can leave the multiple sale menu the same way you leave the fuse menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/99e55bf2528d15da6c7188ecf4e5fec7bd0044b2.png[/img]

We added some more nice changes that players asked us about in social media and at the Steam forum. You’re going to love it 

Let's start with a pleasant trifle — the event window now has a [b]"Skip chest animation"[/b] option. Tick the option to see the rewards right after you spin the wheel. Please note that the animation skipping works only for the "x5" button.

Before the battle starts, you can now see which towers and spells you have tasks for. Such cards have a green line saying "TASK" in the top right corner.

Chat no longer scrolls down automatically when you get a new message from another player or system notification. Autoscrolling will only happen in two cases: when you yourself send a new message or when you reenter the chat room.

And a cherry on top — now you can hire Trickster and Highlander at the same time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/b8f55006be3c6066661a29907b334d6f4cdb72b1.png[/img]

This year we added loads of new content to the game and introduced many other significant changes that influenced both battle and economic balance one way or another. Unfortunately, it led to a devaluation of some truly rare items, making them look like a common and easily accessible content. This shouldn't work like that because, among other things, it has a great impact on players' interest. Defenders 2 is not only a tower defense but partly a collectible card game too. In CCGs, obtaining a rare and valuable card brings a special satisfaction and genuine joy.

Among such items are Legendary All-Purpose Gears and Spell Amplifiers. Basically, they are among the most valuable cards in the game — a kind of jokers that can substitute for any legendary tower or spell. Yet recently it became too easy to obtain them. We decided to restore their well-earned value, so we deleted them from the Hunt mode. From now on you can only find epic All-Purpose Gears and Spell Amplifiers at most. Additionally, Counter Boosters no longer contain feeders for legendary cards. In return, each booster is guaranteed to contain an epic amplifier.

Right now you can receive a legendary All-Purpose Gear as a one-time gift when purchasing 10 Counter Boosters. Moreover, you can win it in the new event!

Other changes in economics refer to tasks. The value of tasks has increased significantly after we introduced regular events to the game because they help the players to earn most of the event currency. At the same time, the price to update the tasks remained unchanged — calculated for common essences. Unfortunately, some players abused this feature to earn too much event currency in a short space of time. All this had a negative effect on the in-game balance in general.

That is why we are bringing in a new progressive cost of task updating. It won't affect average players but will cut short any possibilities of almost infinite and not quite fair farming of the event currency.

Essentially, from now on each subsequent update costs 30 stars more than the previous one — up to 195 stars. Yet, to make it possible for an average player to complete the usual number of tasks per day, the first update of the day costs 15 stars, just like it used to. We'd like to emphasize that when a new day starts, the cost is refreshed to its minimum, which is 15 stars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png[/img]

We also introduced several fixes to make Defenders 2 even more comfortable for you:[list]
[*] Tasks are now available for league towers.
[*] Duelist grants the number of additional assaults that is displayed on his card.
[*] You can no longer insert runes that block the way of flying and underground creeps into Ghost tower.
[*] Banshee tower's description now displays the Lucky Rune effect.
[*] Creeps' cards now display the Defender effect.
[*] If you insert Skill Rune in Sky Eye or Colony of bats, the correct description will be displayed.
[*] The Monopolist and Who needs spells? achievements for Steam, Google, and Apple accounts are now granted when a player earns the third star in Feats instead of the first one.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg[/img]

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/f6b3b51a9b75c82004ad5922c82d8903ad272304.png[/img]

We've been carefully following your comments regarding mythic cards - it has been interesting to see and read what are you thinking about them, — and noticed that you wanted Ghost tower to be more interesting. So, we've added one more property to it — now it can land the flying creeps down! We've also updated the tower's description by stating that it can spot invisible foes.

What is more, we've revised the quality of cards the players of the starting levels receive in the 'Hunt' mode. Now newbies can get more special cards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Mythic towers are stated as counters in the creep cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] You can not put lucky runes into Spider nest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] You can put power runes into Banshee tower, Pumpkin gun, and Spider nest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Pumpkin gun no longer burns the remains of monsters out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Curse spell's damage does not get reduced upon leveling it up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Colony of bats' DOT is now displayed correctly, its animation after build is fixed, and its role is stated correctly in the description.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Trickster's description changed: we've added info about the fact that the Hero also upgrades Spider nest's rate of fire.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Fixed the mistakes in the role description of Highlander and Trickster.

notes.title: Board Defenders — Round 5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/e95008fbe9a071811a89ee9da7f2dd9aff7cd01a.jpg[/img]

Dear friends, we prepared an unusual contest in board game format for you.[list]
[*] Your [b]common goal[/b] is to lead the ship together from start to finish.
[*] [b]The individual task[/b] is to gain as many points as possible during the contest.
[/list]
[b]You can read a complete ruleset [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/429540/announcements/detail/1583503191498612108]here[/url].[/b]
 
In simple terms now you just need to write "+" in the comments section. This way you will roll the dice and when the round ends, the random number generator will provide a number for you.
 
You will then move the ship to a cell of a certain type to earn points. At the end of the contest, three players with the highest number of points will receive valuable prizes:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/e407d111b62eaa65377ae9340b4b135ce5ecf0ea.png[/img] 1 place — any 7-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 3 days of Premium;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/3662d3b20cee9d006673bb0e8c5d15ee36a0dd79.png[/img] 2 place — any 6-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 2 days of Premium;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/599661a993fbb767756462fab8bf1c0cacd6ebc3.png[/img] 3 place — any 5-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 1 day of Premium.
 
[i]* Except for the cards available only during special events. The level of the card matches the player's level.[/i]
 
[quote]In addition, every week we will give away a [b]bonus prize[/b]! Just take part in one round and get a chance to win a nice prize — [b]12 hours of Premium[/b]![/quote]
[b]RA|» Vavtrudner[/b] is the winner of the 4th round of the contest! They will receive 12 hours of Premium. Please add [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/pwdefenders2/]us[/url] to your friends and send us your in-game ID via personal message so that we can send the prize to you. 

If you have any questions about the rules, feel free to leave them in the comments below — we'll be happy to answer them. Good luck everyone!
 
5th round ends at 2 p.m. GMT November 4. Best of luck!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ce9fe0188b53ee5b1dbcddc37aa9a353c9d478fd.png[/img]

Defenders!

What a nightmare has begun in Praya! All Hallows' Eve is coming soon!

Various undead souls entered Praya, and they don’t want to go back to where they came from. What is more, they did not come empty-handed — they brought towers that can scare you to death with them!

Don’t rush into battle with the unwelcome guests. It will be more beneficial to recruit them, and leave the scary towers to yourself! They will be really useful in battle :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/630c2796e421d1ef51c817975f7b845dd2b891cf.png[/img]

[b]Mythic towers and heroes[/b] have appeared in Defenders 2 — and we are eager to tell you how special they are!

They are not simply more powerful than the other towers, but their starting evolution is 6, meaning that they perform in battle differently right away!

Greet the first 5 [b]mythic towers[/b] and… try not to fall back from fear!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png[/img] [b]Colony of bats[/b] floats in the air. Shoots a colony of bats at the target. Bats block invisibility and deal all creeps around it damage. Does not block the creeps' way. But the special feature of this tower is that… it can move!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png[/img] [b]Spider nest[/b] spreads the web that slows all nearby creeps down and increases incoming damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png[/img] [b]Ghost tower[/b] summons ghosts every 2 seconds, but no more than 5. Sends them out fastly when creeps approach.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png[/img] [b]Pumpkin gun[/b] shoots pumpkins that deal damage and slow creeps down.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png[/img] [b]Banshee tower[/b] curses the creeps, making them receive more damage, has a 20% chance of leading creeps astray and forbidding them to use magic.

Four [b]new Heroes[/b] provide bonuses to the [b]mythic towers[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png[/img] [b]Wendigo[/b] increases damage dealt by Spider nest, Ghost Tower, Pumpkin gun, Banshee tower, and Colony of bats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png[/img] [b]Trickster[/b] increases the rate of fire of Spider nest, Ghost Tower, Pumpkin gun, Banshee tower, and Colony of bats. Can not be hired when you’ve already hired Highlander. They do not get along well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png[/img] [b]Nosferatu[/b] increases the toughness of Spider nest, Ghost Tower, Pumpkin gun, Banshee tower, and Colony of bats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4949608ae817ea86966b0b1c4283c7947bc5373d.png[/img] [b]Vixen[/b] increases Banshee tower's, Pumpkin gun's, and Spider nest's efficiency, as well as damage dealt by Ghost tower and Colony of bats.

[b]Mythic cards[/b] are high-level content, so only level 70+ players have access to them. You can get new towers and heroes for opening special boosters, that are sold for red crystals. We kindly remind you that at the moment you can get red crystals only for participating in special events, available for level 70+ players only.

As with any other cards, [b]mythic[/b] ones can be crafted. You will need the same number of shards as needed in order to make a legendary card — 100.

Speaking of evolution. You can evolve a [b]mythic card[/b] only once — up to 7 stars. It does not matter if it is a hero or a tower card, you will need 50 red crystals for this upgrade.

Finishing off the topic of [b]mythic cards[/b], we want to answer a question we believe many want to ask now. Magic is magic for a reason. It must remain mysterious and unknowable, and for now, Primologists do not know how to make it mythic ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/3cc8e160cdaced359a9e32ebb9e63e9cb3f905cf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Game manual has been added into the game. It will help new players to faster adjust to game features. Unlike the tutorial, it is available at all times — to open it up, please click on the book icon on the global map. There you will be able to find short illustrated tips that will explain Defenders 2 core mechanics in a simple way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] You asked us to add Mimi, Soul Catcher, Sesha, Stalker, Maiden, and Fanatic to hero boosters drop. Well, here you go, lads and lasses! Now you can get there Heroes from the hero boosters in the shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Gold hero tokens are dropped from league chests instead of stars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/43737db0915483751f32a1b2661b41f3d6e1009e.png[/img]

You will now need the same type of essences that drop from the corresponding mines to enter league battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/2f04d804997cea57bf1706fb44b6f65650718ae5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Updated rules[/h1]
Defenders! Your brave team entered the mystic portal, but it seems like it only brought the ship back to the starting point. What is more, it threw you into an alternative, twilight realm! In order to get back home, you need to get back to the portal!

It is so dark around you that after a conversation with the other crew members you decided to move a bit slower. Now your maximum speed is 4 instead of 5. Safety first, lads and lasses!
 
What is more, in the alternative reality, the points you gain are counted differently. 
The new formula works this way:
 
[b]P = 0.5*N*E, where[/b][list]
[*] P — the final points score;
[*] N — the number you scored for throwing the dice (from 1 to 4);
[*] E — earned points (from 0 to 2, they are counted in the same way as in the basic rules).[/list]
For example, you scored 1 and earned 1 point, in total, you will get 0.5 points. If you scored 4 and earned 2 points, you will get 4 points, and etc.

Forward, to the new objective! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/65d36033729e9264bfb7956d3612bfd48ef5c6d7.png[/img]

Dear friends, we prepared an unusual contest in board game format for you.[list]
[*] Your [b]common goal[/b] is to lead the ship together from start to finish.
[*] [b]The individual task[/b] is to gain as many points as possible during the contest.
[/list]
[b]You can read a complete ruleset [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/429540/announcements/detail/1583503191498612108]here[/url].[/b]
 
In simple terms now you just need to write "+" in the comments section. This way you will roll the dice and when the round ends, the random number generator will provide a number for you.
 
You will then move the ship to a cell of a certain type to earn points. At the end of the contest, three players with the highest number of points will receive valuable prizes:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/e407d111b62eaa65377ae9340b4b135ce5ecf0ea.png[/img] 1 place — any 7-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 3 days of Premium;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/3662d3b20cee9d006673bb0e8c5d15ee36a0dd79.png[/img] 2 place — any 6-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 2 days of Premium;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/599661a993fbb767756462fab8bf1c0cacd6ebc3.png[/img] 3 place — any 5-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 1 day of Premium.
 
[i]* Except for the cards available only during special events. The level of the card matches the player's level.[/i]
 
[quote]In addition, every week we will give away a [b]bonus prize[/b]! Just take part in one round and get a chance to win a nice prize — [b]12 hours of Premium[/b]![/quote]

[b]Macaroni[/b] is the winner of the 3rd round of the contest! They will receive 12 hours of Premium. Please add [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/pwdefenders2/]us[/url] to your friends and send us your in-game ID via personal message so that we can send the prize to you. 

If you have any questions about the rules, feel free to leave them in the comments below — we'll be happy to answer them. Good luck everyone!
 
4th round ends at 2 p.m. GMT October 28. Best of luck!

notes.title: Terribly interesting party!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/4127a825c9e0cb5c65f2ce42652df93edcc9e9f4.png[/img]

Defenders!
 
Halloween is approaching the Prime Zone, and so are mysterious mythic Heroes. Rumor has it that they look more like monsters than people and have such spooky towers in the arsenal that there was no brave spirit yet who didn't get scared of them!
 
This is why it's much better to gain the intruders over than fight with them. Such allies will be a real godsend for you and their towers will become your vanguard!
 
How can you make friends with the unexpected visitors? Throw a…
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ca2b97b0bf1049f19379e1389b07864526128bf2.png[/img]
 Start preparing for new towers and Heroes right now! Pick some curious costume and start gathering pumpkins — the main symbol of Halloween! Exchange pumpkins for spins of the wheel and win valuable prizes including red crystals. Red crystals are a valuable resource that you'll soon be able to spend on boosters with mythic cards!
 
[quote]Note that this time we have two events — for level 5–69 players and level 70 and above players. We do so because red crystals are high-level content that, together with mythic towers and Heroes, will be available only for defenders of level 70 and above![/quote]
Among the rewards, level 5-69 players may find:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Lots of tower cards and tower card shards — including legendary, league, and flying ones!;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Lots of Hero cards and Hero card shards — from special to legendary ones!;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Useful runes, including valuable turquoise ones;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Other prizes: stars, keys, silver, essences, and all types of Hero tokens. 

Level 70 and above players will receive new and extremely rare red crystals! Red crystals are the only currency that you'll soon be able to spend on unique mythic boosters with towers and Heroes. Additionally, high-level players can win various heroic tokens, card shards with legendary or flying towers, and many other great prizes!

[quote]Please note that if you reach level 70 during the events, the new stage of the event will begin, and your number of spins and pumpkins will be reset. All current rewards will be saved and you will be able to take part in another event with even cooler rewards! In this case, you can contact our tech [url=https://nival.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]support[/url] and we will send you a compensation to make the start in the new event more pleasant and quick. :)[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/1a4a7549c752be4a0881518c46114ec70f4762af.png[/img]
Both events follow the familiar rules - spin the wheel of fortune for pumpkins and get useful prizes! The more spins - the more rewards!

[h1]You can gather the harvest of pumpkins[/h1]
Via in-game methods ([b]get twice more pumpkins by activating Premium[/b]):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] winning in battles, 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] completing the tasks;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] opening chests located on the map, 

Via other ways:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] watching ads (on mobile devices);
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] purchases with stars.

Both events will last [b]until November 11[/b], but take note that: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]23:59 UTC November 10[/b] is the last minute you can get pumpkins via in-game methods. Pumpkins you’ve already collected will be stored on your account for 24 hours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]Until 23:59 UTC November 11[/b], you will be able to use remaining pumpkins to spin the wheel. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] After that, pumpkins will disappear from your account. 

Be sure to make it before the mythic cards appear — collect as many red crystals as possible!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/85ddc7e39c31b7e2004e4ca5f41f917b8ec7c328.jpg[/img]

Dear friends, we prepared an unusual contest in board game format for you.[list]
[*] Your [b]common goal[/b] is to lead the ship together from start to finish.
[*] [b]The individual task[/b] is to gain as many points as possible during the contest.
[/list]
[b]You can read a complete ruleset below.[/b]
 
In simple terms now you just need to write "+" in the comments section. This way you will roll the dice and when the round ends, the random number generator will provide a number for you.
 
You will then move the ship to a cell of a certain type to earn points. At the end of the contest, three players with the highest number of points will receive valuable prizes:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/e407d111b62eaa65377ae9340b4b135ce5ecf0ea.png[/img] 1 place — any 7-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 3 days of Premium;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/3662d3b20cee9d006673bb0e8c5d15ee36a0dd79.png[/img] 2 place — any 6-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 2 days of Premium;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/599661a993fbb767756462fab8bf1c0cacd6ebc3.png[/img] 3 place — any 5-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 1 day of Premium.
 
[i]* Except for the cards available only during special events. The level of the card matches the player's level.[/i]
 
[quote]In addition, every week we will give away a [b]bonus prize[/b]! Just take part in one round and get a chance to win a nice prize — [b]12 hours of Premium[/b]![/quote]
If you have any questions about the rules, feel free to leave them in the comments below — we'll be happy to answer them. Good luck everyone!
 
The first round ends at 2 p.m. GMT October 7. Best of luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/2e2fbe2b42e4185541e48a103495632143f2cc24.png[/img][list]
[*] [b]Common goal[/b]: lead the ship from start to finish.
[*] [b]Individual goal[/b]: earn as many points as possible.
[/list]
[quote][h1]Updated rules[/h1]
Defenders! Your brave team entered the mystic portal, but it seems like it only brought the ship back to the starting point. What is more, it threw you into an alternative, twilight realm! In order to get back home, you need to get back to the portal!

It is so dark around you that after a conversation with the other crew members you decided to move a bit slower. Now your maximum speed is 4 instead of 5. Safety first, lads and lasses!
 
What is more, in the alternative reality, the points you gain are counted differently. 
The new formula works this way:
 
[b]P = 0.5*N*E, where[/b][list]
[*] P — the final points score;
[*] N — the number you scored for throwing the dice (from 1 to 4);
[*] E — earned points (from 0 to 2, they are counted in the same way as in the basic rules).[/list]
For example, you scored 1 and earned 1 point, in total, you will get 0.5 points. If you scored 4 and earned 2 points, you will get 4 points, and etc.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/1667bcfc276c61f0ab4a627cabc4fcb4ac1163af.png[/img]
[b]Board Defenders[/b] is a sort of a board game with all players working together to move the ship from start to finish. To roll the dice, you just need to write "+" in the comments section of the contest announcement (1 comment from 1 participant per round). When the round ends, the random number generator will determine how far (from 1 to 5 cells) a player moved the ship.

[quote][b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b] we take into account the succession of the comments. Those who write "+" early will roll the dice and move earlier too. The next player moves from the cell where the previous player landed.[/quote]
Each following round will provide a quick recap of the previous round — for you to see clearly the contribution of each participant. [b]The round starts at 2 p.m. on Friday and ends at 2 p.m. on Monday GMT.[/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/ad4b28ee9e6f1b5847a40b46d5fbbcacfa12eb9b.png[/img]
The Board Defenders map is a [b]Defenders 2[/b] map in a board game style. It has a path the ship needs to travel and cells of various types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/85ddc7e39c31b7e2004e4ca5f41f917b8ec7c328.jpg[/img]

[quote]IMPORTANT NOTE: The mechanics below might seem difficult at first. Don't worry about it: we will calculate everything for you and at the end of each round will let you know which number (from 1 to 5) you rolled, which cell you got, and how many points earned :)[/quote]
By rolling the dice a player moves the ship to one of six cells:[list]
[*] [b]Chest[/b] — the player is guaranteed to receive 1 point.
[*] [b]Assault[/b] — the player receives 1 point if the number rolled is higher than or equal to the previous player's number. If there is no previous player, the next player's number is taken.
[*] [b]Hunt[/b] — the player receives 1 point if the number rolled is lower than or equal to the previous player's number. If there is no previous player, the next player's number is taken.
[*] [b]Raid[/b] — the player receives 1 point if the number rolled is not equal to the previous player's and next player's number. If there is no previous or next player, only one number is considered — that of the previous or the next player.
[*] [b]PvP Mine[/b] — a player steals 1 point from the previous and/or next player if the number rolled is higher than the previous player's and/or the next player's number. For example, Player 1 rolled "1", Player 2 rolled "3" and hit PvP Mine, Player 3 rolled "5". In this case, Player 2 steals 1 point from Player 1 but no points from Player 3. Player 1 loses 1 point if they scored more than 0! If Player 1 has 0 points in the round, they won't lose anything, and Player 2 won't earn 1 point.
[*] [b]League Mine[/b] — works just like PvP Mine but to steal a point the player needs to roll a number lower than the previous player's and/or next player's number.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/3edba1449fa31db850577bddaa23cb64e4244db6.png[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/2703c830a36dd7290382d4f3e5a61af291897d93.png[/img]
Three players with the highest number of points will receive valuable prizes:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/e407d111b62eaa65377ae9340b4b135ce5ecf0ea.png[/img] 1 place — any 7-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 3 days of Premium;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/3662d3b20cee9d006673bb0e8c5d15ee36a0dd79.png[/img] 2 place — any 6-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 2 days of Premium;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34017216/599661a993fbb767756462fab8bf1c0cacd6ebc3.png[/img] 3 place — any 5-star card (a tower, spell or Hero) of your choice* + 1 day of Premium.
 
[i]* Except for the cards available only during special events. The level of the card matches the player's level.[/i]
 
Additionally, every week we will run a giveaway for a [b]bonus prize[/b] among all the participants of the round (those who wrote "+" in the comments) — [b]12 hours of Premium[/b]. Please note that one player can receive multiple bonus prizes during the contest.
 
The number of rounds and the date we sum up the results depend on how fast the players manage to move the ship from start to finish.

notes.title: Game update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/c37784ce0a33a6d21ee15ebc5993d30331a8be49.jpg[/img]

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/d1d55de3a81afb043991e084bd14507e33e070fa.png[/img]

A unique thematic event takes place in Defenders 2 for the first time! The perfidious government of Praya have caught poor aliens and imprisoned them in the secret base. Your task is to help the unlucky creatures get out of this protected area.

To travel to the secret government base, click the alien-shaped button. Click it again if you want to go back to the global map.

The level of the location on the military base does not depend on the player’s level. It increases with each victory in the hard mode and decreases by one with each defeat. The level of the base is additionally decreased once per day.

Inside the military base, you can come across modified versions of some enemies — Goblin-soldiers, Chameleons, Harpy-scouts, and even APC!

Fighting government troops requires fuel. Fuel fully restores once per day or you can instantly restore it in the Shop for Stars. Premium subscribers get a bonus — twice as much fuel!

Victories will grant you event currency that you can spend on special chests — find them in a separate tab in the Shop. Here you can also use Stars to purchase a bonus for one more chest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/035188572c6424dac99c7492bbe0ab880db8ceaa.png[/img]

The event chests may contain some truly valuable and rare loot — alien Heroes and alien towers! They can be obtained only through the thematic event, so you’d better hurry up 

Against government troops, alien towers work better than the ordinary ones:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Locator can reveal Chameleons;
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Mechanical Tower sustains Goblin-soldiers’ attacks incredibly well;
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Splitter penetrates the armor of APC;
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Repairing Tower is better at repairing than Engineering Tower;
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Flying Saucer ignites creeps beneath it.

Enlist the support of the alien Heroes and your alien towers will become even more powerful:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Mechanic increases damage dealt by Locator and toughness of Mechanical Tower;
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Operator increases damage dealt by Splitter;
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Dispatcher increases power of Repairing Tower;
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Pilot increases damage dealt by Flying Saucer.

At the end of the event, all alien towers and Heroes will remain a part of your collection!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Witch Doctor increases Curse’s power instead of damage per second.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] When pointing to the crystal of a card, a tooltip describing its rarity pops up.

Have fun in battles!

Dear Friends,
We have prepared an unusual competition, this time organized as a game, especially for you. Let's say, it's a Battleship game, but instead of ships, creeps and various bonuses are placed on the grid. Players should shoot with different types of projectiles and kill monsters, concealed on the squares of the grid. When every single creep is killed, we will announce the results of the competition! Three players with the best scores will get valuable rewards:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/a47915dd66c8cbb8419bff17c0a901ca196e1663.png[/img] 1st place - 3 runes of choice upgraded to 7 stars + 500 stars
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/3662d3b20cee9d006673bb0e8c5d15ee36a0dd79.png[/img] 2nd place - 2 runes of choice upgraded to 6 stars and 1 rune of choice upgraded to 7 stars  + 300 stars
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/c5f4fb3efc078ededb555bfc56d17badc5048db2.png[/img] 3rd place - 1 rune of choice upgraded to 5 stars, 1 rune of choice upgraded to 6 stars, 1 rune of choice upgraded to 7 stars + 100 stars.
 
Also, each week we will be giving away intermediate rewards — [u][b]300 stars[/b][/u]! Just hit creeps and get a chance to receive a pleasant prize!

Judging by the entries left in the 18th round of the contest, the one to receive 300 stars is [b]rahasleal[/b]! Congratulations! Write us a PM and tell us your in-game ID to get your reward!
 
[h1]You can find complete rules of the game [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/429540/announcements/detail/1801910106575809654]here[/url].[/h1]

In a nutshell, your task is to name three squares in the comments and specify a type of projectiles (ground, air or underground) you want to shoot with. For example, X1 ground, Y1 air, Z1 underground.

notes.title: Game update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg[/img]

Friends!

A brand new update for [b]Prime World: Defenders 2[/b] is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/e087cfa3cd97e212651ce976c78189198fdb4a91.png[/img]

[b]A new cross-platform premium subscription[/b] was added into the game. It can provide you lots of pleasant bonuses:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]In a fight:[/b] the game can be speeded up to x4.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]After the battle:[/b] +50% to tower/spells experience, 2 rewards instead of 1.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]On the map:[/b] +50% Silver/Essences from mines, chests, and tasks.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]During events:[/b] x2 event currency for opening chests, completing tasks, and participating in battles.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] A new ship skin.

You can[b] purchase the subscription for 15 or 30 days[/b] in the Shop or by tapping on your avatar. Subscription is cross-platform and does not bind to a single device, it is bind to the account. By purchasing it on one platform, you can continue to use its benefits on any other one (iOS, Android, or Steam).

If you renew the subscription while the previous one is active, new premium days won't replace the already purchased ones but will add up to the remaining premium time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/bacf299e9a0c3c3367284b7f3dd1615e24452174.png[/img]

[b]3 new League Towers[/b] were added to Defenders 2: Tower of the Sun, Volcano, and Prime Arrester. Their characteristics are 20% higher than their original versions’.

We've also added [b]10 new Heroes[/b]. Dendromonster slows the underground creeps down, Highlander increases all towers' rate of fire, and the remaining 8 Heroes enhance different spells' powers.

What is more, now Hero bonuses are displayed on the cards in the Collection tab, not only in battle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/456ca7e4eb789e8a6a38877198584f0f1f159b84.png[/img]

We've reworked a few achievements to make it easier for you to unlock them:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]'Assaulter'[/b], [b]'Hunter'[/b], and [b]'Raid'[/b] - you need to win only 250 battles instead of 1000 in the corresponding modes now.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]'Mighty Wizard'[/b] - you need to cast 20 000 spells instead of 100 000 now.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]'Master Builder'[/b] - you need to build 5 000 towers instead of 100 000 now.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]'Mission Impossible'[/b] can now be received for completing 250 missions instead of 500.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] [b]'Who Needs Towers?'[/b] achievement has been removed from the mobile version of the game (you needed to win a battle without building a single tower).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Tearaway/Shadow can now be made from 10 shards instead of 25 as it was before.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Tornado kills creeps, which allows you to complete the corresponding task.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Glowworms dissolve if Tornado/Purifier affects them.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Imir's and Duelist's abilities now work properly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Heroes' abilities are now working in all of the mines.

notes.title: Game Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg[/img]

Friends!

A brand new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is now available! Here goes the full list of new features and fixes that will take place right after you download the new patch:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/c8d0a84020d9397afc21e215a24852148068a7bb.png[/img]

14 Heroes were added into the game. What is more, the way crew works in the game was completely changed. Both new and old Heroes are now represented in the game in the form of cards. Those can be evolved, fused, or sold. You can not put runes into them though.

New Heroes can be obtained 2 ways: during the time-limited events or purchasing Hero Packs at the Shop. The latter may contain both Cards and Card Shards. You can receive more Shards by watching ads on mobile platforms.

Please consider that the old Heroes can also be obtained for logging into the game on a daily basis or for reaching certain account levels.

Hero Packs can be purchased with new currency - Tokens. They can be of 3 types: Gold, Silver, or Bronze. You can obtain them by selling Towers, Spells, or Heroes. The type of the Tokens you receive depends on the number of stars of the card you sell.

UI was changed quite a bit. A new tab was added for you to store your Hero Cards, where you can learn about their battle bonuses, characteristics, and lore. We also reworked the ‘Crew’ tab: now you can hire up to 20 Heroes instead of 6.

What is more, we’ve altered the effect that depends on Ship’s beautification level. Now this upgrade provides a bonus to experience gained for fusing Hero Cards.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/3cc8e160cdaced359a9e32ebb9e63e9cb3f905cf.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] News block added. By tapping on it, you can learn everything about the important changes in the game. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] x5 button was added to the Wheel of Fortune, allowing you to receive 5 rewards in one tap.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Duelist’s ability now works correctly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] You can no longer put Spire Rune, Root Rune, Ingenuity Rune, and Ascension Rune into the flying towers. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Fixed an issue that caused players who do not own League Flying Smasher receive orders on it. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] If the Wheel of Fortune window is still opened when the event is already over, it automatically closes. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] In the Steam version of the game, the ‘Refresh’ button at the available update screen was changed to ‘Exit’ button.

notes.title: Breaking news!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/743d9aba508969b1dae337efcccc34cc8297b55d.jpg[/img]

Friends!

As you already know, the first global in-game event in #Defenders2 ended last week. Whilst it was active, you were able to obtain special tokens, Golem hearts, which could be used for spinning kobold’s wheel. The event provided an opportunity to receive rewards for the number of spins made and find them in the wheel’s slots. Of course, the most valuable prizes in this even were the unique flying towers. This was our plan on making you happy and entertained with an additional activity with cool rewards.

However, what’s good in theory is not always as good in practice. We saw complains from players who made 600+ spins and did not receive the Flying Smasher (and because of this, they were unable to get some other rewards). Friends, we understand that this is not how it should be. According to our calculations, the 4th tower should have been received for fewer spins. Probability theory is a hard thing to master, however, it is undeniable that all we wanted to bring you is joy, not sadness. 

[h1]We want to make things right:[/h1]
[quote]🌟 If you made from 600 to 799 spins during the event and did not obtain Flying Smasher, you will receive Flying Smasher, Flying Prime Arrester, and League Sky Burner.

🌟 If you made from 800 to 999 spins during the event and did not obtain Flying Smasher, you will receive Flying Smasher, Flying Prime Arrester, League Sky Burner, and League Sky Eye.

🌟 If you made more than 1000 spins during the event and did not obtain Flying Smasher, you will receive Flying Smasher, Flying Prime Arrester, League Sky Burner, League Sky Eye, and League Flying Cannon.[/quote]

All these rewards will be sent to you during the next week. At the same time, we will be preparing a new in-game event for you. Whilst making it, we are proceeding and taking into account all of your critique, comments, opinions, and suggestions we received. We promise that the rewards will be revised, and it will become easier to get them -- we will do all that’s required to prevent any unpleasant experience since we love you all so much!

Thank you for your activity in the game and the interest in our events!

[i]Stay tuned and follow our social media to know what’s up in Defenders 2 as fast as possible![/i]

notes.title: Game update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg[/img]

Friends!
A brand new version of Prime World: Defenders 2 is installed to our servers! Get to learn about all the new features that will take place as soon as you download the update in this post!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/65d36033729e9264bfb7956d3612bfd48ef5c6d7.png[/img]

Flying towers have appeared in Praya! They don't block the way for the monsters. Ground enemies pass under them, and air ones - over them. Each of the 5 new towers has a league version.
[list]
[*] [b]Sky Burner[/b] (epic) - sets the creeps passing under it on fire for 3 seconds.
[*] [b]Flying Cannon[/b] (legendary) - deals damage to enemies under itself.
[*] [b]Flying Prime Arrester[/b] (legendary) - deals damage in a small area under itself.
[*] [b]Sky Eye[/b] (legendary) - reveals invisible creeps and those enemies, who hide in the fog. League version of this tower can navigate the map.
[*] [b]Flying Smasher[/b] (legendary) - drops down stones, which roll towards the closest monsters spawn point and stun ground creeps for 0.5 seconds.
[/list]
You can obtain flying towers during special events. You can learn about them below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/65d36033729e9264bfb7956d3612bfd48ef5c6d7.png[/img]

New limited time events grant you an opportunity to win various prizes: runes, keys, and, most importantly, - flying towers. Receive your rewards by spinning the Wheel of Fortune or fulfilling certain tasks.

You can spin the Wheel using either stars or special currency, - Golem Hearts. You can get it for winning in battles, completing tasks or find it in chests on the map. In the mobile version of the game, Golem Hearts can also be received for watching ads.

The most precious rewards, including flying towers, can be received for fulfilling special tasks, such as, for example, spinning the Wheel of Fortune 25 times. If the prize you get is a tower, by receiving it, you will unlock a more difficult task. The league version of the same tower will be the reward for completing it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/65d36033729e9264bfb7956d3612bfd48ef5c6d7.png[/img]

Now you can fastly upgrade towers by several levels at a time in battle. Click on the new icon in the radial menu, and the tower's gun will get upgraded to the maximum level, depending on the amount of Prime you have. The possibility to level up the old way, - by one level, - remains available.

notes.title: Game update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg[/img]

Friends!

A brand new version of [b]Prime World: Defenders 2[/b] is installed to our servers! Get to learn about all the new features and fixes that will take place as soon as you download the update in this post!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/f6b3b51a9b75c82004ad5922c82d8903ad272304.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] 3 new League towers added: Ice Tower, Air Guard, and Detonator. You can receive the shards of the first one in the League Mines, starting with Silver I, and the shards of the second and third one starting with Legend III League. Shard may also drop from the League Boosters in case you reached Silver I and League III Leagues correspondingly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] League Towers bonus changed. Now it is equal to a 20% boost of the main stat of the tower instead of a 10% damage boost. You can see which parameter is boosted right on the tower card.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] When 'High quality' option is turned off, FPS restriction turns on. Frame rate of the game becomes limited to the frame rate of the screen.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Steam achievements are added. If you have previously fulfilled conditions for some achievements, you automatically get them after updating the game. If you transfer your progress from smartphones/tablets to PC using Facebook, the achievements, received on mobile platforms will be unlocked in Steam.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Player's rate in league mines rating is marked with color.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Tasks, which have the “Collect” button, are shown above all the rest.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] New tasks are added for Prime Thistle and Shiny Crest.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Chinese localization refined. All credits for the improvements go to 文渊. If you want to help us translate Defenders 2 to your native language, please write us a message on [url=https://www.facebook.com/PrimeWorldDefenders/]Facebook[/url].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] During a battle, a bonus from an anomaly on which a Tower is standing on can be seen in the Tower menu.

notes.title: Battleship. Round #1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/154f261edbeff7bbd9d8ae124826d79e97bc5162.jpg[/img]

Dear Friends,
We have prepared an unusual competition, this time organized as a game, especially for you. Let's say, it's a Battleship game, but instead of ships, creeps and various bonuses are placed on the grid. Players should shoot with different types of projectiles and kill monsters, concealed on the squares of the grid. When every single creep is killed, we will announce the results of the competition! Three players with the best scores will get valuable rewards:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/a47915dd66c8cbb8419bff17c0a901ca196e1663.png[/img] 1st place - 3 runes of choice upgraded to 7 stars + 5 Tower Boosters
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/3662d3b20cee9d006673bb0e8c5d15ee36a0dd79.png[/img] 2nd place - 2 runes of choice upgraded to 6 stars and 1 rune of choice upgraded to 7 stars  + 3 Tower Boosters
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/c5f4fb3efc078ededb555bfc56d17badc5048db2.png[/img] 3rd place - 1 rune of choice upgraded to 5 stars, 1 rune of choice upgraded to 6 stars, 1 rune of choice upgraded to 7 stars + 1 Tower Booster.
 
Also, each week we will be giving away intermediate rewards — [u][b]3 League Boosters[/b][/u]! Just hit creeps and get a chance to receive a pleasant prize!
 
[h1]You can find complete rules of the game below. In a nutshell, your task is to name a square in the comments and specify a type of projectile (ground, air or underground) you want to shoot with. For example, X1 ground.[/h1]
 
If the rules seem difficult, just ask your question in the comments and we will be happy to explain all the unclear aspects :-)
 
The first round will finish at 2 p.m. (GMT) on March 25. Good Luck!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/c05d08afdb3666120a44969f1131954409bcb648.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/16bea170665e4c8cc65128edcafddfa7713cba30.png[/img]
[u][b]The aim of the game:[/b][/u] kill all the creeps on the grid.
 
The grid is a big square with 20×20 individual squares. Individual squares are identified by letters (from A to T) on the horizontal axis, and by numbers (from 1 to 20) on the vertical axis. For example, A1, B15, G9, and so on.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/057e68e7af48a48dc51faf792199488a1a5d8343.jpg[/img]
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/450c74cd1b23afd937cc85450751d4d99d9e6df7.png[/img]
24 monsters are concealed from players. There are 8 ground, 8 flying and 8 underground creeps located on the grid. Players should kill them all. 

[u][b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b][/u] monsters and bonuses (read more about them below) that are arranged on the grid do not overlap or touch one another! There is at least one empty square vertically, horizontally and diagonally between them.
 
All the monsters are divided into common creeps, epic creeps, and bosses. 
 
Any type of a common creep (ground, flying, underground) occupies one individual square. 5 common ground creeps, 5 common flying ones, and 5 common underground monsters are hidden on the grid. 
 
Any type of an epic creep occupies 4 communicating squares (arranged either horizontally, vertically or diagonally). In addition, all the epic monsters are shaped differently. Players don't know what shape these monsters have. 2 epic ground monsters, 2 epic flying and 2 epic underground ones are hidden on the grid.
 
Any type of bosses occupies 7 communicating squares (arranged either horizontally, vertically or diagonally). In addition, all the bosses are shaped differently. Players don't know what shape these monsters have. 1 ground boss, 1 flying boss and 1 underground one are hidden on the grid.

[u][b]Example.[/b][/u] From right to left: common ground monster, epic flying creep, underground boss.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/bd7a3c6ae1db79ea573da1475e199082389a21b0.jpg[/img]
 
[u][b]Taken all together:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 15 common monsters;
[*] 6 epic monsters;
[*] 3 bosses.
[/list]
For destroying any common monster, a player gets 2 Prime. 
 
For hitting any epic monster, a player gets 2 Prime. For killing any epic monster (final shot), a player gets 3 Prime. 
 
For hitting any boss, a player gets 2 Prime. For killing a boss (final shot), a player gets 4 Prime. 
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/cc428f4f0ddac544d6b5014c09662153ed4404f7.png[/img]
For each type of creeps, there are corresponding types of projectiles: ground, air and underground. A flying monster can be killed only with air projectiles, a ground enemy - only with ground projectiles, and an underground creep - only with underground projectiles. 
 
Common monsters die when hit by the right type of projectile. Epic monsters and bosses die only when all the squares occupied by a monster have been hit (it's 4 squares for epic monsters and 7 for bosses).
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/436b882811dd883a9f8a41e645b0379ffae0a3a8.png[/img]
The game is divided into several rounds. Each round lasts for 3 days, during which players write comments with coordinates of a target square and a type of projectile that they use for shooting. For example, A1 air, B15 ground, G9 underground, and so on. 

[u][b]Please note:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] You will be able to make 3 shots on each stage of the game, but the shots must be OF A DIFFERENT TYPE - 1 ground, 1 air, 1 underground! 
[*] If a player names a square, but does not specify the type of projectile, the shot does not count. 
[*] If two or more players announce the same square with the same type of projectile, the first announced shot is taken into account. 
[*] If two or three players taim for the same square, but using different types of projectiles, such shots will be considered as different.
[/list] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ec95cd44fe2a476e6dd42d514979400fe78fb81e.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/154f261edbeff7bbd9d8ae124826d79e97bc5162.jpg[/img]

After a player shoots at a square, it either changes its color or a particular icon appears on the square.
 
[u][b]Color code:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Yellow — a ground projectile hit this square. There is no ground creep on this square, but there might be an underground or a flying creep. 
[*] Blue — an air projectile hit this square. There is no flying creep on this square, but there might be an underground or a ground creep. 
[*] Red — an underground projectile hit this square. There is no underground creep on this square, but there might be a ground or a flying creep. 
[*]  Green — ground and air projectiles hit this square. There is no ground or flying creep on this square, but there might be an underground one. 
[*]  Purple — underground and air projectiles hit this square. There is no underground or flying creep on this square, but there might be a ground one.
[*] Orange — underground and ground projectiles hit this square. There is no underground or ground creep on this square, but there might be a flying one.
[*] Black — all three types of projectiles hit this square and there is no creep in there.
[/list] 
If a player hits a creep, one of six icons will appear on a target square. 
A blue icon indicates for a wounded creep; a red one stands for a dead creep. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/2d79bc937d3b343d6aaf00fdca8d206d3325ebd9.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/89e41f21828f714ad157c7caad10b748361e47cf.png[/img]
Besides creeps, there are bonuses, concealed on the grid: 
[list]
[*] Prime (10 items on the grid) — adds 5 bonus Prime to player’s score
[*] ‘Meteor’ spell
[*] ‘Prime Explosion’ spell
[*] ‘Chain Lightning’ spell
[*] ‘Mine’ spell
[/list]
You can claim one of the enlisted bonuses by hitting them with any type of projectile! 
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/1db685baca4cdaa2ea8f1fe833c903aee1b70b05.png[/img]
8 spells are hidden on the grid: two of each type. If a player ‘hits’ a spell, in the next attack, instead of simple projectiles, they will use magic (the use of magic can’t be postponed to another turn). 
 
Each magic attack affects defined area and is able to hit particular type of creeps: 
[list]
[*] Meteor (4 squares) — hits all types of creeps
[*] Prime Explosion (4 squares) — hits all types of creeps
[*] Chain Lightning (3 squares) — hits ground and flying creeps only
[*] Mine (3 squares) — hits ground and underground creeps only
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/0f2b16d0aa96e48db8caacf133288bbacdbeb10d.png[/img]

[u][b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b][/u] when using magic, a player doesn't have to write 3 or 4 targeted squares that they'd like to hit! It is enough to just announce [u][b]the lower left square[/b][/u]. Take a look at the example above. In order to shot with Meteor, as it is shown on the figure, it is enough to announce C15, for Prime Explosion— G14, for Chain Lightning — L14, in order to lay a Mine — Q15.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ba4148e5534a5c3b1aed3ec1485601f39083d507.png[/img]
Rounds take place once a week and last for 3 days — starting at 2 p.m. (GMT) on Friday and finishing at 2 p.m. (GMT) on Monday. When a round ends, we collect answers that all the participants left and count their shots. Using this data, we update the grid and count points.

All players who scored at least 2 points in a round take part in a round reward drawing. [u][b]The prize is 300 stars.[/b][/u] The drawing takes place after every round, and a winner is chosen randomly. Winner’s name is announced when the new round starts. 

The total number of rounds depends on how fast participants will destroy the creeps. When the game is over, we will summarize the results of the competition and announce the names of three winners who scored more points than others.

[u][b]Main prizes:[/b][/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/a47915dd66c8cbb8419bff17c0a901ca196e1663.png[/img] 1st place - 3 runes of choice upgraded to 7 stars + 500 stars.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/3662d3b20cee9d006673bb0e8c5d15ee36a0dd79.png[/img] 2nd place - 2 runes of choice upgraded to 6 stars and 1 rune of choice upgraded to 7 stars  + 300 stars.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/c5f4fb3efc078ededb555bfc56d17badc5048db2.png[/img] 3rd place - 1 rune of choice upgraded to 5 stars, 1 rune of choice upgraded to 6 stars, 1 rune of choice upgraded to 7 stars + 100 stars.

If you have any questions regarding the rules of the game, please, ask them in the comments and we would be glad to answer them. Good Luck!

notes.title: Rune update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/41a7c4e91c826b453250d06423c2aaf66842da30.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mystics of Praya brought some great news! [/h1]
For many years in a row, they were unraveling the mysteries of the runes, studying their properties. In their search, they stumbled upon 2 wondrous discoveries, and they are eager to share them with you!

It occurred that you can enhance not only towers with the magic stones but also spells. Yet this discovery was not as amusing as the second one. Mystics found a way to merge similar runes, making them stronger. Today they will share the secrets of this process with you!

Friends, as you may have already understood, the brand new Prime World: Defenders 2 update is dedicated to runes and magic. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/74b8eab942a91441b8ea0f7ff74e8e7551bbf606.png[/img]
[h1]And here goes the full list of new features, which will take place in the game as soon as the patch is installed to our servers:[/h1]

🔮 Focus Runed were added into the game. They are used for upgrading different entities which belong to the 1st and 4th cells in battles. Same as with towers, spells can now level up, and to do so, you don’t even need prime. Spells level up automatically with each rise of the battle’s difficulty, yet not higher than the value determined by runes. Focus runes can be won in ‘Assault’ mode, purchased at the shop in the ‘Random’ section, or found in the chests on the global map. The minimum rarity of the new runes is special (green). The effect of the two inserted runes is cumulative.

🔮 When you enter a level in a higher difficulty, the number of spells you can use in fight restores to the initial one.

🔮 A new function of merging runes has been added to the game. Now 4 similar runes can be merged into the same one but of a rarer quality.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/74b8eab942a91441b8ea0f7ff74e8e7551bbf606.png[/img]
In the nearest future, we will introduce one more update to you, which will add new content to the game and make Defenders 2 even more comfortable and interesting. 

[i]Stay tuned![/i]

[quote]✨ And 2 more small, but important announcements: ✨ 

1) As compensation for the long maintenance, we are giving away 50 stars to everyone who enters the game after this update!

2) We are truly sorry that iOS (mobile) version of the game is currently unavailable. Due to the tech issues on Apple servers, the update installation will take more time. We can't announce when exactly it will happen since the problem is not coming from our side. [/quote]
