notes.title: Changes in PvP rating
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/602efef6d645262d8b52dba8523fb26ab7ff0570.png[/img]
Greetings, friends!

After yesterday's update, some of you may have noticed that your PvP rating had been reduced. In some cases, the difference in today’s and yesterday’s rating was equal to up to 1000 points! We would like to explain to you why this happened.

At the end of the previous year, we [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/429540/announcements/detail/1696067271041097503]wrote[/url] that PvP rating can be counted incorrectly in some cases. This lead to a situation where many players' rating became higher than their real one. The last update has fixed this bug, and now PvP rating points are being counted correctly for each and every one of you. In order to keep everything fair, we withdrew all the incorrect rating points from the game.

If your rating changed after yesterday's update, it did not become lower - it simply got back to its correct state!

There won't be any players with unreachable rating displayed in the Leaderboards anymore. Now literally anyone can climb their way to the top!

We wish you to have lots of fun in battles and glorious victories!

notes.title: Game update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/90d7b360de051e4a41a22872f04c2104649e17ad.jpg[/img]
Friends!

A brand new version of Prime World: Defenders 2 is installed to our servers! Get to learn about all the new features and fixes that will take place as soon as you download the update in this post!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/f6b3b51a9b75c82004ad5922c82d8903ad272304.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] 3 new league towers have been added to the game - Wooden Cannon, Cleansing Tower & Digging Hunter. They differ from their default versions by 10% increased damage. Wooden Cannon shards can be obtained in league mines, starting with Stone I league. Cleansing Tower & Digging Hunter can be obtained at the same place starting with Bronze I league. What is more, shards can be received via League Booster in case you’ve already reached the necessary leagues (Stone I and Bronze I, correspondingly).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Now you are able to zoom in and out of the battlefield using the scroll wheel. Zooming in and out with double clicking is no longer possible.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Zooming in and out on the global map now works properly. Scrolling up zooms the map in, scrolling down zooms it out. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Graphics optimized. A new additional option - High Quality, - was added. By default, it is turned off. This allows to significantly increase FPS while keeping a decent level of detalization. If you want the effects to be displayed, put a check mark next to this option.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Now you can close different screens (victory screen, messages and etc.) by clicking on an empty space. There is no need to press ESC to do so anymore.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/0d54d78fc180228901716a5b15394cb9a277cbc6.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Fixed the incorrect number of essence needed for evolving league Spray Tower. Now its evolve price is the same as the original tower’s. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Counter icons are now displayed correctly within the frames. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Fixed a bug which made Blinkers teleport too often.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] Hotkeys are now working in the magic tutorial. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/ddaf5574610e1873ed22bba05782f3c7d0fc9b1f.png[/img] ESC button now works correctly after you collect the daily reward.

What is more, today is the day for us to name the winners of the “Guess the new tower’s names” contest! [b]alveolate[/b] is the only player to guess 2 towers from 3 correctly! In rewards, he/she is able to choose any of the new league towers for us to send her/him - Wooden Cannon, Cleansing Tower or Digging Hunter!  We kindly ask the winner to contact our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/pwdefenders2/]official Steam account[/url] via private messages, name his/her game ID and the tower he/she wants to receive. alveolate, congratulations to you! And a huge thank you to everyone, who participated in the contest :-)

Friends, a new update for Prime World: Defenders 2 is coming up this month! We are going to introduce 3 new towers to you in it. But what will those be? Guess that! The one who will guess them right will receive one of these towers as a reward!

[h1]Conditions:[/h1]

The whole list of already released default and league towers can be seen [url=https://prime-world-defenders-2.fandom.com/wiki/Towers]here[/url].  
2. Only 1 comment per participant is accepted. If you leave more entries or write more than 3 towers in your comment, your entries won’t be accepted at all. Do not worry, off-topic (non-entry) comments are more than welcome! We will gladly answer your questions about the contest if you have any.
3. In case there will be more than one participant who guesses towers correctly, the winner will be chosen randomly.

notes.title: Future plans
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/9dc0b0070b6f3e662fb059bc7f5fc7aedae3e34d.jpg[/img]

Hello!

A few months ago we released Defenders 2 in Steam. And it was… Thrilling! We were pleasantly surprised that PC-gamers were so excited about it. And we are not speaking about all the thumbs up reviews you left us (by the way, thank you so much for them!). We are speaking about your activity on the forum and feedback we receive every day. 

We are so glad to see how you help each other, share tips and tricks, discuss game mechanics. You are always trying to back your points of view up with facts, keeping it cool and nice. Your conversations are extremely interesting to read!

And, of course, we want to thank you for all the idea, suggestions and… criticism, too. There is nothing in this world which does not require a bit of healthy criticism :)  Your feedback is helping us make Defenders 2 better. We read all your comments, so be sure that they do not remain unnoticed. By the way, some of your suggestions rise some pretty epic discussions within our dev team!


It’s true that we can’t implement all your ideas and suggestions into the game. But some features you asked us about have either already released (hotkeys, faster mouse scroll), either are going to be added to Defenders 2 soon. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/daa05c93270436ea2e5b86a26c67fac37eebf3a5.png[/img]

We know that a huge number of players is interested in Steam Achievements. We will add ours soon!

We also understand that it is important to be able to launch the game in windowed mode (tbh, we miss it ourselves, too :D). We have not been able to make this change yet, but we are currently working on it, so don’t worry!

We’ve also received a very unexpected request from a group of players. They asked us to make paid DLCs for Steam, so that Defenders 2 do not disappear from their Libraries. Lads, who find this point important - we’ve got your back! 

And yet another important element - UI. You do know that Defenders 2 was originally developed for mobile platforms, don’t you? :) We’ve already brought some alterations to the PC version of the game, so that it is more comfortable to play on this platform, but there are still some things that can be changed for good, so we will continue working on making the game better. We will refine the UI to make it more suitable for bigger screens. 

And the most important part - we will need time to implement these and other ideas to Defenders 2. We receive dozens of interesting suggestions, but we need to analyze them first and think them through.

Next patch is going to be released this month, and it won’t introduce both windowed mode and achievements to the game, but we want you to know that we remember about these matters and we are working on them. And even more cool alterations are waiting for you in the nearest future!

[h1]Thank you for staying with us! 
We wish you fun battles, powerful towers, and glorious victories![/h1]

notes.title: Christmas update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/9784deb49ca040e652cb7cbcb1b22ede037f92f7.jpg[/img]

Dear Friends,

We reached out to Santa and asked him about the most popular request from Defenders 2 players. Without thinking twice, the old man answered: "New towers!" Needless to say, after that we wanted to know if you played nice during the year. And, once again, without hesitation, the cheerful old man exclaimed: "Impeccably!" If so, we invited him to assist us with some Christmas magic, in order for a small miracle to occur. And here it is: please, welcome the new towers in Defenders 2!

That's it, with Christmas in the offing, we have prepared the new update for Prime World: Defenders 2!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/b93cf5c758139690b0b5c96c06daa8566fe830eb.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/0453727cf915902e2ab0ad98d0b07a326cf095d1.png[/img] Two new legendary towers - Shiny Crest and Prime-thistle - have been introduced into the game. Shiny Crest is a well-armored battle unit, which frightens the enemies and attracts their attacks. Prime-thistle is a planter with a plant that infects enemies with spores, has long-distance shooting range and deals additional damage to totems. Also, we have introduced league versions of Seismic Slammer, Fog Tower, Spirit Tower, and Whizzer. You can obtain shards of each of six new towers by getting top places in league mines or by purchasing League Booster in the shop. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/0453727cf915902e2ab0ad98d0b07a326cf095d1.png[/img] Tooltips in the Steam version of the game became more informative.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/35ebaecb93ff8530cd86a79a0c65f5d6c1e05967.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/0453727cf915902e2ab0ad98d0b07a326cf095d1.png[/img] The discount icon for special offers is now displayed correctly. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34017216/0453727cf915902e2ab0ad98d0b07a326cf095d1.png[/img] An error in the runes tutorial interface has been fixed.

Dear Friends, we wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! We hope that the upcoming year will be filled with tons of happiness, fun, joy, and good memories. May 2019 be all you want it to be! But please, remember that the creeps do not celebrate holidays, thus, the Defenders 2 world is always in need of loyal Defenders, whose spirit is indomitable and towers are fortified!
